description: PK (1/2) — Driving: sp_license_certificate_document (NHNCK.CERTIFICATE_RECORDS). Grain: 1 CCHN per NHN

source_attribute: Securities Practitioner License Certificate Document Code

description: Mã loại hình hành nghề (= CERTIFICATES.CERTIFICATE_CODE)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN sp_license_certificate_document ON sp_license_certificate_document.sp_license_certificate_document_id = driving LEFT JOIN sp_license_certificate_type ON sp_license_certificate_type.sp_license_certificate_type_id = sp_license_certificate_document.sp_license_certificate_type_id → sp_license_certificate_type.sp_license_certificate_type_unique_key
source_attribute: SP License Certificate Type Unique Key

description: Tên loại hình hành nghề (= CERTIFICATES.CERTIFICATE_NAME)
Ngày thu hồi CCHN — NULL nếu chưa thu hồi
Số quyết định cấp CCHN — ETL-derived: join sp_license_decision_document theo issue_sp_license_decision_document_id
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN sp_license_decision_document ON sp_license_decision_document.sp_license_decision_document_id = sp_license_certificate_document.issue_sp_license_decision_document_id AND sp_license_decision_document.src_stm_code = 'NHNCK_DECISIONS' → sp_license_decision_document.decision_nbr

description: Số quyết định thu hồi CCHN — NULL nếu chưa thu hồi
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN sp_license_decision_document ON sp_license_decision_document.sp_license_decision_document_id = sp_license_certificate_document.revocation_sp_license_decision_document_id AND sp_license_decision_document.src_stm_code = 'NHNCK_DECISIONS' → sp_license_decision_document.decision_nbr

description: Tên trạng thái CCHN — ETL-derived: denormalize từ Classification (scheme: LICENSE_CERTIFICATE_PROCESS_STATUS) tại thời điểm populate
etl_logic: INNER JOIN cv ON cv.scm_code = 'LICENSE_CERTIFICATE_PROCESS_STATUS' AND cv.cl_code = sp_license_certificate_document.process_status_code → cv.cl_nm
